thesis: RTX Corporation (NYSE: RTX): Collins Aerospace, Pratt & Whitney, Raytheon. Q3 2026 10-Q (filed 2026-10-20). Q3 net sales 24,965M vs 22,478M (+11.1%, organic +2.6B); nine month sales 71,749M vs 64,365M (+11.5%); nine month operating profit 8,703M vs 6,704M (+29.8%; includes about 0.2B tariff refunds); nine month NI to common 6,781M vs 5,110M. Backlog 340B (commercial 176B, defense 164B) vs 268B at 2025-12-31; Q3 Raytheon bookings 52B. TTM (USD millions, FY2025 10-K + 9M26 - 9M25): NI to common 8,403; OCF 12,435; capex 2,934; FCF 9,501; stock compensation 637; FCF after SBC 8,864 (also 474M of 9M26 share based 401(k) matching, non cash). Close 193.44 (2026-11-19) x 1,349,440,548 shares (cover and balance, 2026-09-30) = 261.0B = 31.1x TTM NI; FCF yield 3.6% (3.4% after SBC). Debt: short term 210M + current long term 5,679M + long term 31,490M = 37,379M vs cash 9,173M, net debt about 28.2B (principal 37,253M, average maturity about 12 years); 9M interest expense net 1,188M vs 1,349M; S&P outlook BBB+ positive; noncontrolling interest 125M in Q3 earnings. Possible market view: peak aerospace cycle priced in. Price implies sustained double digit growth and margin gains; differing evidence is the record backlog and falling interest cost, but it does not show cheapness.
counterthesis: 31x TTM earnings and a 3.6% FCF yield leave little room for error; TTM earnings include tariff refunds and non-service pension income of about 1.0B in nine months (non operating). Net debt of about 28B and 5.7B due within a year; goodwill 53.0B of 176.6B assets. Backlog jump to 340B is driven by 52B of Q3 defense bookings, lumpy and government dependent. Pratt & Whitney GTF powder metal matter remains a financial exposure (note read in outline only, amounts not extracted); DPAs, FCA settlement and a Navy Administrative Agreement (2026-09-21) carry suspension or debarment risk. Working capital: contract assets rose 2.2B and inventory 1.7B in nine months. SG&A rose 0.5B in Q3. Not a mispricing candidate on current numbers; it is a quality compounder at a full price. Peers (GE, HWM, LMT, NOC, GD) and own history not compared.
invalidation: Thesis of resilient quality at a full price is invalidated if organic growth slows below high single digits, if commercial aftermarket weakens, if a GTF or defense program charge or debarment action appears, or if FCF falls below net income.
